Build is clean now (exit code 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage after ~950 lines of harmless deprecation noise:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now passes options as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`; `resolveRetries` was still reading the old key and crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` rather than `false`; `isBackoffEnabled` only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false`.

The remaining 8 warnings in the output are just deprecation/lint noise from the dependency bump (Node API deprecations, an unused export, a circular import) — not build-breaking, so left as-is unless you want those cleaned up too.
